scope: Selected UR transform reading, comparison and save withdrawal policy in12.8.2.3.

source.force: Extended-rights validation rules use shall. Withdrawal after an excessive edit uses should. This product has no feature requiring an extra entitlement; its own selected withdrawal policy is the tested subject.
source.errata: Parent inspected actual annotations589–592. #152 on589 concerns preceding Table257 P integer; #33 on592 concerns FieldMDP names, not UR.

features.implementation: signature::UsageRights reads table arrays, version and P; revision::Comparison classifies eight of23 operations, names fifteen unrecognised rights. No unknown operation is certified.
features.assertions: revision.rs granted Create versus deleted annotation; added Delete changes only its result, deleted page stays Unclassified. Pfalse and unknownV/Ptrue controls distinguish parameter policy. These synthetic revision fixtures test comparison rather than complete cryptographic validity.
features.decision: Retain separation of transform classification from cryptographic/path validity. Pfalse bypasses restrictions as a documented reading; not a newly enabled feature entitlement.

features.implementation: ViewState::save handles annotation additions, imports and other changes, but withdrawn_usage_rights checks only FillInForm and FullSave.
features.finding: B40: a real signed fixture granting those two unrelated rights retains UR3 after adding a Highlight even when Annots/Create is withheld. Matched Create-granted control retains it as expected.
features.execution: usage-rights-wave36.log:1FAIL after signed digest/authenticity and attached-annotation controls pass.
features.qualification: Adopted-policy regression against a SHOULD, not a mandatory conformance violation. No trust/entitlement claim. Existing forms_data test covers only form fill and uses an unsigned signature dictionary carrier.

residuals: All23 rights, all save operations, full public report/path validation and permission precedence combinations remain outside this sample.
